full_text:
Unnamed Titan 011 has the appearance an Egyptian-themed reptile man wearing a brown tunic and a striped nemes-like headdress. In its hand it wields a golden staff with a green gem. This Titan specializes in labor enforcement and keeping smaller Titans in line.

History

DeFoe used this Titan in the desert to mount Unnamed Titan 012 and keep it from growing rebellious. [SAS-140]

Abilities

This Titan is skilled in enforcing hard labor and encouraging obedience amongst other Titans, "remotivating" and intimidating them to get back to work.

Trivia

• This Titan appears to inspired by Sobek, a crocodile-headed Egyptian deity associated with pharaonic power and military prowess who was known to possess protective powers. Its reptile-man appearance makes it similar to Akamaru and Venomaster.

'''Unnamed Titan 011''' has the appearance an Egyptian-themed reptile man wearing a brown tunic and a striped nemes-like headdress. In its hand it wields a golden staff with a green gem. This Titan specializes in labor enforcement and keeping smaller Titans in line.  

== History ==
[[DeFoe]] used this Titan in the desert to mount [[Unnamed Titan 012]] and keep it from growing rebellious. {{Source|TCG:SAS-140|SAS-140}}

== Abilities ==
This Titan is skilled in enforcing hard labor and encouraging obedience amongst other Titans, "remotivating" and intimidating them to get back to work.

== Trivia ==
*This Titan appears to inspired by [[:wikipedia:Sobek|Sobek]], a crocodile-headed Egyptian deity associated with pharaonic power and military prowess who was known to possess protective powers. Its reptile-man appearance makes it similar to [[Akamaru]] and [[Venomaster]].
